title: The Home Up There
firstLine: This is not our rest, this is not our home,

lines: This is not our rest, this is not our home,
We are trav'lers bound for a world to come;
Comes full soon the end of life's little day,
And our place found empty, for we fly away.
To the home up there oft we turn our eyes,
When a dear one dies; Then we vision here of a city fair,
Where will end the partings in the home up there.
Precious home up there which the Lord prepares
For the ones whose names in His book appears!
How our fond hearts yearn for the Lord's return,
When we'll meet together in the home up there.
O! it won't be long till we reach our home,
Where no death invades, where no trouble comes;
Where we'll sigh no more 'Neath the loads we bear,
Be with Christ forever in the home up there.
